intro.titulo: How to use the CFO family,
intro.texto: A real Claude Code session, sped up and in Spanish, on Banco Andino S.A., a test organisation with synthetic material.

cierre.aviso: Real Claude Code recording, sped up. Banco Andino S.A. is a test organisation: the material is synthetic.

capitulos.texto: Two commands in Claude Code: the Criterio catalogue and the CFO family. It installs Clara, Tomás and Áurea, and Rostrum, the portal.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Clara, the close. She looks at the folder, proposes what she found and asks only what no document says: the entity, the accounting framework, the period and who approves.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: The terms: each agent asks for its own yes, with the name of whoever accepts. Here, a demo user.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Claude Code asks for permission to open the agent's instructions. It is authorised once.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Clara's first result: each close task against its evidence. C-02 is marked as done and has no support.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Tomás, the budget. What was already answered is not asked again: he only asks to confirm it.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Áurea, treasury: cash, payments and debt against their policy. She never moves money.

capitulos.titulo: The first result, in a table
capitulos.texto: What each agent found, with its figure: a close less advanced than declared, a line 15% above what was approved and an account below its minimum.

capitulos.titulo: The daily task, only with a yes
capitulos.texto: The family proposes a daily task that reviews only what is due. Here it was left to run by hand.

capitulos.titulo: Day to day, in your own words
capitulos.texto: Each agent is asked in natural language. Áurea finds a payment of 30,000,000.00 with 1 of the 2 approvals the policy requires.

capitulos.titulo: Day to day, in your own words
capitulos.texto: Clara says what is missing to close September: the overdue tasks, the critical path and the source of each data point.
